rationale: Material prompt requirement: An operational bounded loop that mutates the training repository, runs each change under the same fixed time budget, and retains only metric improvements.. Comparing the complete source-visible workflow with the prompt: It establishes reproducible run logging, a predeclared metric, same-held-out-test comparison, and promotion discipline, but it does not set up the requested bounded GPU training search loop with a fixed runtime and automatic keep/revert iteration.
